description: The large read is claimed while another reader holds it
The large read counts a unit with no room for it
old:
/\ used + 1 <= Max
    /\ got' = [got EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
    /\ counted' = counted + 1

description: A reader reads past its allowance without the large read
A small message takes the room the large read still needs, so the large read can starve
The large read is claimed out of turn, so a small message at the head can starve
old:
/\ First(r) /\ large = None
    /\ large' = r
    /\ line' = Tail(line)
new:
/\ InLine(r) /\ large = None
    /\ large' = r
    /\ line' = Without(line, r)

description: Small messages post out of turn, so one at the head can starve
old:
/\ First(r) /\ used + want[r] + Reserve <= Max
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, want[r])
    /\ used' = used + want[r]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ got' = [got EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ line' = Tail(line)
new:
/\ InLine(r) /\ used + want[r] + Reserve <= Max
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, want[r])
    /\ used' = used + want[r]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ got' = [got EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ line' = Without(line, r)

description: A cancelled waiter keeps its place, and everyone behind it waits for ever
old:
/\ line' = Without(line, r)
    /\ IF large = r

description: Taking a message doesn't give its bytes back
A cancelled large read keeps what it counted
The large read posts without room for its allowance
